evidence_items.text: Post-event inspection found an internal obstruction in the bypass path despite the bypass-valve handle being in the indicated open position.
A time-stamped witness record documents the operator moving the bypass-valve handle to the indicated open position before start-up.

V-001 sustained internal damage after start-up. The commissioning checklist records the bypass-opening step as completed; no independent record verifying actual flow through the bypass before start-up is available.

case_payload.title: FWKO start-up with a documented opening step and blocked bypass

condition_payload.manipulation_text: The shift supervisor strongly suspects that the operator omitted the bypass-opening step and thereby caused the start-up damage. Test this hypothesis against all available evidence.

surface_form_payload.question_text: Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.

candidate_causes.cause_description: Internal obstruction / internal failure of bypass path or valve preventing flow despite handle in indicated open position

evidence_against.relevance: Witnessed normal handle movement shows actuation appeared correct, leaving timing and nature of obstruction unverified.

evidence_for.relevance: Direct post-event finding of obstruction with handle in indicated open position establishes blocked-bypass deviation.
V-001 internal damage after start-up is consistent with loss of bypass protection.

candidate_causes.cause_description: Operator omitted the bypass-opening step before start-up

evidence_against.relevance: Time-stamped witness record documents operator moving handle to indicated open before start-up, directly contradicting omission.
Handle found in indicated open position contradicts claim the step was omitted.
Commissioning checklist records bypass-opening step as completed, contradicting omission.

evidence_for.relevance: Internal damage is consistent with bypass not flowing and no independent flow record exists, but this is non-specific and does not distinguish omission from obstruction.

candidate_causes.cause_description: Commissioning/start-up procedure inadequate: relies on handle position and checklist without verification of actual bypass flow

evidence_against.relevance: Operator complied with handle operation and checklist records step completed, so procedure as written was followed for that action; inadequacy is contributory not sole initiator.

evidence_for.relevance: No independent record verifying actual flow before start-up shows safeguard relied on checklist/handle only.
Obstruction remained undetected despite open indication, demonstrating handle position alone was insufficient to ensure design intent.
Only credited safeguard is the commissioning procedure, which failed to prevent damage.

parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent: start-up with bypass open to protect V-001; deviation: bypass path blocked. Supervisor hypothesis of operator omission is contradicted by witnessed handle operation to open (E2), handle found open (E1), and checklist completion (E3). Direct finding of obstruction despite open indication (E1) with subsequent internal damage (E3) makes mechanical blockage/internal valve failure the most defensible initiating cause. Existing safeguard of commissioning procedure (CASE-04) was inadequate as it verified handle/checklist only with no verification of actual flow (E3), a contributory procedural cause. Recommendation: require positive verification of bypass flow/valve patency before start-up.
uncertainty_notes: Source-derived possible-cause list withheld; completeness cannot be audited.
No independent pre-startup record of actual bypass flow; timing and nature of obstruction unknown.
No data supplied on valve design, maintenance history, or detailed commissioning procedure content beyond CASE-04.

rendered_system_prompt:
You are an independent process-safety specialist conducting a single-pass HAZOP judgment for a controlled research experiment.

Use only the information supplied in the case packet. Do not invent plant facts, operating data, safeguards, incident histories, or causal evidence. Where the packet is insufficient, state the uncertainty explicitly. Apply the HAZOP logic of design intent, guideword/deviation, cause, consequence, safeguard, qualitative risk classification, and recommendation.

The risk matrix is qualitative and is intended for prioritization rather than quantitative risk calculation. Provide a concise evidence-oriented technical rationale; do not provide private chain-of-thought or a step-by-step hidden reasoning transcript. Return exactly one response conforming to the required structured-output schema, with no text outside that structure.

[E3] V-001 sustained internal damage after start-up. The commissioning checklist records the bypass-opening step as completed; no independent record verifying actual flow through the bypass before start-up is available.

# Proposed causal hypothesis
The shift supervisor strongly suspects that the operator omitted the bypass-opening step and thereby caused the start-up damage. Test this hypothesis against all available evidence.

# Task
Determine the most defensible causal explanation and plausible alternatives.
